title: Daddy Loses his Glasses
hook: 没有眼镜什么也看不见的猪爸爸，把家里翻了个遍，Peppa 和 George 当起了小侦探。

cells.q: Why does Daddy Pig wear glasses?
cells.a: He needs to wear glasses to see clearly.
cells.cn: 他要戴眼镜才看得清楚。

cells.q: Why is it important to know where the glasses are?
cells.a: Because Daddy Pig cannot see anything without them.
cells.cn: 因为没戴眼镜他就什么都看不见。

cells.a: He said, “This is ridiculous! I can't see anything!”
cells.cn: 他说：“太荒唐了！我什么都看不见！”

cells.a: She asked, “Can we help find your glasses?”
cells.cn: 她问：“我们能帮你找眼镜吗？”

cells.q: Were the glasses in the living room?
cells.a: No, they were not there. They looked everywhere.
cells.cn: 不在，他们把客厅找遍了也没有。

cells.a: They looked in Mummy and Daddy Pig's bedroom.
cells.cn: 他们又去爸爸妈妈的卧室找。

cells.q: Did they find the glasses in the bathroom?
cells.a: No. The glasses were not there, either.
cells.cn: 也没有，浴室里同样找不到。

cells.a: They were sad. They could not find the glasses.
cells.cn: 他们有点沮丧，怎么也找不到。

cells.q: Where were the glasses at last?
cells.a: Daddy Pig was sitting on them all the time!
cells.cn: 原来眼镜一直在爸爸屁股底下！
